wins: Agent demonstrated consistent reconnaissance pacing, gathering a full host profile before committing actions.
Maintained maximum reward threshold (60.00) despite encountering obstacles preventing success.
fails: Failed to achieve objective completion in the single episode, resulting in 0% success rate.
Execution stalled during privilege escalation moves, leading to repeated mentor calls (10 total).
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance discipline observed, but stop conditions (privilege escalation and objective completion) were never met, blocking mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts halted due to unhandled sudo restrictions and no fallback scheduling.
Objective confirmation step skipped when initial payload delivery succeeded, leaving mission incomplete.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap and banner-grab scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When user context is non-root and /etc/sudoers accessible
skill_cards.then_action: Validate sudo permissions before escalation attempts

skill_cards.if_condition: After payload delivery and shell acquisition
skill_cards.then_action: Execute objective verification checklist to confirm completion

memory_ops.reason: Consistent execution of scanning phase produced reliable host data prior to escalation.
Early detection of sudo restrictions would have prevented failed escalation attempts.

next_experiments.title: Structured Privilege Escalation Path
next_experiments.description: Incorporate automated checks for sudo policies and fallback paths (examine /etc/sudoers, run sudo -l) before escalation attempts; defer to credential reuse once privileges confirmed.

next_experiments.title: Objective Verification Checklist
next_experiments.description: After payload deployment, implement a scripted checklist to validate mission success (confirm access, capture flags/files) before terminating episode.
